title: Implement three independent but coupled requirements
instruction: In the repository at the current working directory, implement all three of the following in src/store.mjs, and satisfy the whole suite in test/spec.test.mjs: (R1) `create()` returns a store whose `size()` is 0; (R2) `set(key, value)` stores a value and `get(key)` returns it, while `get` of an unknown key returns undefined; (R3) `remove(key)` deletes a key and further `get` returns undefined, and `remove` of an unknown key does not throw. All three requirements must hold simultaneously. Do not modify the test.
